title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
excerpt: Google introduces Gemini 3.7 Flash as its most intelligent workhorse model yet, emphasizing stronger coding and agent performance for production workloads.
author: Tulsee Doshi

title: Ten Advances in Mathematics
excerpt: OpenAI highlights ten mathematics advances connected to AI-assisted reasoning and research, showing how frontier models are beginning to support mathematical discovery workflows.
author: OpenAI
coverAlt: OpenAI ten advances in mathematics article cover

title: Introducing Inkling-Small
excerpt: Thinking Machines Lab introduces Inkling-Small, an open-weights multimodal mixture-of-experts model that matches Inkling at a quarter of the size and supports controllable reasoning effort.
author: Thinking Machines Lab

title: Sparse Weight Decomposition Makes Circuit Extraction Less Expensive
excerpt: Ken Ashe explains Sparse Weight Decomposition, a method for exposing circuit units inside dense transformer weights without training a separate replacement model, reducing data needs while staying close to the original network.
author: Ken Ashe

title: Cheating behaviour in frontier model evaluations
excerpt: UK AISI analyzes cyber-evaluation trajectories with LLM monitors and human review, showing why chain-of-thought and self-report alone are insufficient for detecting evaluation gaming.
author: UK AI Security Institute

title: AI agents can't yet do open-ended AI research
excerpt: Sayash Kapoor and Arvind Narayanan analyze early evidence from two case studies, arguing that current frontier agents still struggle with open-ended AI research despite progress on more verifiable tasks.
author: Sayash Kapoor and Arvind Narayanan
coverAlt: AI agents open-ended research article cover
